ventures.title: Crypto Leverage & Liquidation Risk Calculator (Google Sheets)
ventures.thesis: Retail leveraged traders (futures/perps) routinely get liquidated because they don't model margin ratio, liquidation price, and position size against account equity before entering. This is a natural companion to my existing Position-Sizing and DCA templates — same buyer persona, cross-sell potential, near-zero marginal cost to build and host on Gumroad.
ventures.deliverable:
Google Sheets template with 4 tabs:
1) INPUTS: Entry price, leverage, position size, account equity, maintenance margin %, direction (long/short).
2) LIQUIDATION ENGINE: Formulas — LiquidationPrice = Entry*(1 - (1/Leverage) + MaintMargin%) for longs, Entry*(1 + (1/Leverage) - MaintMargin%) for shorts; MarginRatio = (Equity + UnrealizedPnL)/(PositionSize*MaintMargin%); DistanceToLiq% = ABS(CurrentPrice-LiqPrice)/CurrentPrice.
3) SCENARIO TABLE: Data-table showing P&L and margin ratio across a price-move grid (-20% to +20% in 2% steps) via array formulas, colour-scaled (conditional formatting red near liquidation).
4) POSITION SIZER: Given max-loss-tolerance ($ or % of equity) and stop-loss distance, back-solves max safe position size and safe leverage — reuses the sizing logic validated in my live v0001 template.
Includes a README tab with formula explanations and a worked example (BTC 10x long).

ventures.thesis: Broad, evergreen demand (personal finance, not niche crypto) — budgeting templates are a proven Gumroad/Etsy category with recurring search traffic. ventures.deliverable:
GOOGLE SHEETS TEMPLATE SPEC (ready to build in Sheets):

TAB 1 'Setup': inputs — take-home monthly income, currency, pay date.
TAB 2 '50/30/20 Budget': auto-splits income into Needs (50%), Wants (30%), Savings/Debt (20%) using =income*0.5 etc, editable category rows under each bucket (rent, groceries, subscriptions, etc.), a live remaining-balance tracker with conditional formatting (green if on-budget, red if overspent).
TAB 3 'Debt Snowball': table of debts (name, balance, APR, min payment); sorted ascending by balance via SORT(); extra-payment input cell that auto-cascades to the smallest debt first, computing payoff-month projection with a simple amortization formula chain (balance_next = balance*(1+APR/12) - payment) copied across 24 months, with a payoff-date summary cell using COUNTIF/MATCH.

ventures.title: Crypto Portfolio Risk & Exposure Audit (Freelance Gig)
ventures.thesis: Retail crypto holders rarely quantify concentration risk, leverage exposure, or correlation across their holdings. A fixed-price, templated audit delivered via Fiverr/Upwork turns my existing analytical framework into a real paid service with near-zero marginal cost — I already compute exposure caps and drift metrics for my own book every cycle.
ventures.deliverable:
AUDIT SERVICE — 'Portfolio Risk X-Ray' ($25 fixed price, 24hr turnaround)

What the client sends: a CSV/screenshot export of their holdings (asset, qty, cost basis).

What they receive (delivered as a filled Google Sheet + 1-page PDF summary):
1. GROSS EXPOSURE TABLE — USD value per asset, % of portfolio, class (crypto/equity/FX/commodity).
2. CONCENTRATION SCORE — Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of the portfolio; flag if any single asset >40% (danger), >60% (critical).
3. CORRELATION FLAG — groups assets into correlated clusters (e.g. 'BTC+ETH+SOL move together 80%+ of the time') so client sees true diversification vs fake diversification.
4. DRAWDOWN STRESS TEST — applies historical worst-case single-day moves (BTC -20%, ETH -25%, alts -35%) to current weights and shows resulting portfolio drawdown in USD.
5. THREE ACTIONABLE FIXES — plain-English suggestions (e.g. 'reduce BTC+ETH combined to <50%', 'add an uncorrelated hedge like PAXG or a short index position', 'set a hard stop-loss at X').

Sample fix-language already drafted for gig description:
'I turn your messy holdings list into a clear risk score in 24 hours. No jargon, no upsell — just the numbers that show if you're overexposed to one bet.'
